projects.title: Linguine - Natural Language Processing Educational Tool
projects.description:
A Natural Language Processing tool backed by Stanford CoreNLP and the Python Natural Language Toolkit (NLTK). The tool aims to teach NLP concepts and algorithms to students by performing common analysis tasks and visualizing the results. Students can use the tool to upload large corpora and visualize processes such as sentiment analysis, coreference resolution, and several others. The tool is being actively maintained and used in the College of Liberal Arts at the Rochester Institute of Technology. 

Technologies: Node, Angular, Python3, SnarfordCoreNLP, NLTK, D3js

projects.title: MintRewards - Codechella
projects.description: Worked with a small team to develop the winning solution to Intuit’s Codechella competition, allowing small business owners to request feedback for their products through user notifications generated based on transaction data.
